scope: Fixed coefficients from one eight-cell state. Numerical applicability and conservation of a spherical continuum solver, not a new equilibrium, angular-refinement result, substellar geometry equivalence or population-accuracy certificate.
publication: Scalar-only inspected review. Private source-derived coefficient/stellar arrays and NPZ files are not copied or published.

old_local_norm.definition: max over cells and frequencies of abs(delta(r^2 H)-V(eta-chi J)) / (abs(r_in^2 H_in)+abs(r_out^2 H_out)+V(eta+abs(chi J)))
old_local_norm.interpretation: The local relative check rejects valid finite positive Green responses after subnormal/underflow operations. This contradicts its applicability to every response in this fixture, not the physical energy equation. The historical failure remains recorded.

new_global_norm.definition: max over frequencies of sum_cells abs(delta(r^2 H)-V(eta-chi J)) / [sum_cells V(eta+max(-chi,0)J)+(Rin^2 Iin+Rout^2 Iout)/4]
new_global_norm.zero_source: Zero error only when source and total absolute defect are both exactly zero; nonzero defect with zero source gives infinity.
new_global_norm.coherent_scattering: Use true absorption and emission in the outer energy balance; internal coherent scattering is not injected energy or heat.
new_global_norm.independent_mean_error_metric: max_cells abs(J_float64-J_longdouble) / max_cells abs(J_longdouble), at each frequency; all cells included.
new_global_norm.independent_algorithm: Same rounded geometry and point transfer equations; independently written NumPy longdouble chord sweeps and partial-pivot elimination. The geometry is not independently refined by this experiment.
new_global_norm.interpretation: This is an explicit change of the diagnostic norm, with independent same-state precision checks. It is not a claim that the old local-relative condition now passes, nor a relaxation of the numerical value 1e-9.

limitations: Global conservation does not imply relative accuracy of an arbitrarily faint cell or population.
Angular, radial, frequency, state/thermal, observer and implicit-derivative refinements remain separate requirements.
Spherically averaged illumination is a declared closure and is not Yapeng substellar model equivalence.
The six complete-use assessment statuses and basis digests are unchanged.
